note: The streaming gate's documents (rs/tests/streaming_test.rs, ts/test/streaming.test.ts, go/cmd/dmog/streaming_test.go; AGENTS.md, "The streaming gate"). For each format, a document of n items is `head`, then `item` once for each index i from 0, with {i} the index, `separator` between two items, and then `tail`; {text} in any of them is `text`. The gate reads a document of `items` items and one of ten times as many. An item is a short distinct name, which a run that keeps something of every item holds, and a long plain text, so that the document of `items` items is longer than the lexer's window holds (about 192 KiB) at a few events an item. Every format the formats table lists has a document here, but those ruled whole.
